construction: 20 parts in 4 steps. Step 1, the Technic mount: two plates 1×2 with an offset peghole underneath, a long axle pin and a 1×2–1×2 bracket. Step 2: trans-clear and trans-orange lens plates and a grooved tile on a second bracket. Steps 3–4: inverted curved slopes, slopes and tiles form the housing; an axle connector and a 3L axle finish the mount.
interfaces: The parent places it with the axis permutation `0 0 1 / 1 0 0 / 0 1 0`. The offset-peghole plates, long axle pin and axle connector join it to the bumper.
lesson: A sideways System lamp cluster sits on a Technic mount; only the parent's axis-permutation matrix explains its orientation.
parent_context: The left headlight cluster in the bumper of the truck (`42078 - tractor.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Use it where a System lamp must sit on a Technic body: the peghole plates and pin give the Technic interface, and the brackets turn the lenses. For the right side, build a real mirror image with real parts; never reflect the matrix.
